item.title: Welcome to my website!
item.description:
Hello and welcome to my new website! I finally got around to putting a new face on the things I've had around for a while. I think I last updated my website in 2019, so this is long overdue. I'm also hoping this is a kick in my butt to start putting new things out there. Despite what my "Art & Music& section says, I *have* made things since 2022, I've just been very bad at putting them online. I endeavor to do better :prayer-hands:


I also want to try keeping up with writing posts on this blog. I don't think I've had a blog since AP English Lit my senior year of high school. I'm hoping to not recreate that experience 1:1, but if I end up reviewing The Road again you can't blame me, it's just muscle memory.

TEST
